coaching_overview: This 4-week Base Building block establishes aerobic foundation and tempo fitness for marathon training. Week 1 (38.5km) anchors the plan on current Strava data (recent runs at 6:50/km easy, 6:00/km tempo). Volume progresses within the 10% rule: Week 2 (+7.8% to 41.5km), Week 3 (+7.2% to 44.5km, peak), Week 4 (−20.2% to 35.5km recovery). Long run grows from 12km → 14km → 15km → 12km, respecting the 1-2km per week increment rule. Two quality sessions per week (tempo on Saturday, intervals on Tuesday/Monday) deliver the polarized 80/20 intensity split, with no hard sessions on consecutive days or adjacent to the long run. Tempo paces at 6:01/km match current fitness; interval pace at 5:45/km (15 seconds faster) develops VO2max capacity. All sessions fit within the 7-hour weekly time budget. After recovery in Week 4, the next block will shift to Aerobic Development phase with progressive long runs, marathon-pace introduction, and continued intensity work.
